title: GTA 6 Might Make $1 Billion Before You Can Even Play It
caption:
GTA 6 may pass $1 billion before launch day: Sensor Tower estimates $1B+ in digital pre-orders (Take-Two hasn't confirmed). GTA V took three days to hit $1B in 2013.
Are you buying day one?

Sources: Sensor Tower, Take-Two (Sept 2013)
